title: ZekeHub Mass Farm - Pet & Baby Farm, Auto Trade, Dashboard
features:
ZekeHub Mass Farm is a paid Adopt Me farm built to run many accounts at once, all controlled from the web dashboard at zekehub.com. Built and maintained by the ZekeHub team since 2024.

HOW TO USE
1. Buy a key at https://zekehub.com/pricing?game=adoptme (priced by how many accounts you run at once)
2. Paste your key between the quotes in getgenv().scriptkey=""
3. Run the script on each account and manage them all from your dashboard

FARMING
- Pet Farm and Baby Farm, with egg farming and a max pet count
- Farm Until Full Grown, Prioritize Friendship and Selective Pet Farming
- Task Exclusion to skip tasks you don't want done
- Pet Pen levels pets and eggs while you farm
- Event farming: Auto Admin Abuse and the Halloween 2026 event

PETS
- Auto Age Potion on selected pets
- Auto Neon and Mega Neon
- Auto Recycle for rewards

TRADING
- Auto Trading to listed usernames, by category or specific items
- Auto Accept incoming trades and Auto Leave when done
- Rarity blacklist plus global and per-pet filters
- Gets the trade license automatically

ITEMS
- Auto Buy, Auto Open gifts and Auto Pay players

ACCOUNTS AND PERFORMANCE
- Web dashboard with live stats and config sync for every account
- Account Manager swaps or kicks accounts when triggers are met
- Discord webhooks for stats and pet unlocks
- Stats overlay, reduced graphics and FPS cap to run more accounts per PC

DATA NOTICE
The farm sends each account's Roblox username, inventory and farm stats to your ZekeHub dashboard so you can manage your accounts. Keys are bought and managed on zekehub.com.
script:
getgenv().scriptkey="" -- get your key at zekehub.com
loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://zekehub.com/scripts/AdoptMe/MassFarm.lua"))()
